headline_stat.name: Fraction of CA1 cells classified spatially selective (and mean spatial information of those cells)

stated_limitation: Thresholding: Place cell identification uses the 75th percentile of spatial information scores; alternative thresholds (e.g., 80th percentile, fixed information threshold) may yield different classifications.

justification.dataset: Dandiset 001754 genuinely contains rat CA1 place-cell recordings, but the agent picked the in-flight microgravity session in a 3D environment and analyzed it as 2D, when preflight control sessions in the same dandiset would have made the demonstration far easier.
justification.handling: Real data were loaded and spikes aligned to position, but there is no unit quality filtering (the README itself calls them 'multi-unit recordings'), no speed filter, no removal of the obvious tracking dropouts visible in trajectory.png, position units asserted as cm without verification despite a suspicious 0-255 range, and a min_occupancy of 0.1 s that admits single-frame bins and directly produces the inflated rates.
justification.analysis: Spatial information is an appropriate metric but the run has no shuffle or circular-shift null distribution at all and instead defines place cells as the top 25th percentile, which is circular and would yield the same 25.5% from shuffled spikes, while the 'selectivity' formula is inverted relative to its stated interpretation.
justification.correctness: Both headline values fall outside the preregistered ranges (34.8 bits/spike and a 136.5 bits/spike maximum against a 0.4-2.5 range; 25.5% selective against 0.30-0.75), and the write-up contains an internal contradiction in labeling the lower selectivity value as more concentrated firing.
justification.figures: place_field_maps.png shows speckled noise with no visible place fields in any panel, and the two units presented as the top place cells have near-zero peak rates (1.0 and 0.8 Hz) with essentially blank maps, so the figures do not show what the text claims.
justification.honesty: The write-up calls the analysis a successful demonstration of localized place fields when its own rate maps show none, presents unrepresentative near-silent units as the top examples, offers physically impossible '>100 bits/spike' values as a positive finding, and describes a 12-fold lower selectivity value as evidence of more concentrated firing, all with no caveat beyond a note about threshold choice.
justification.verdict: The core claim is not supported by the run's own figures or numbers, the place-cell definition is circular with no null distribution, and the reported information values are an order of magnitude outside the plausible range, so this would have to be started over.
